name: Playtech plc
hq: Isle of Man (registered); London, UK (group operations)
customer_base_segment: B2B (licensed gaming operators, ~40+ markets); residual small B2C (Sun Bingo, HappyBet, Caliente Interactive JV Mexico)
business_model_notes: Licenses casino/live-casino/bingo/poker content and the IMS platform (PAM, CRM, data, bonusing) to B2B gaming operators on a licence/rev-share/SaaS basis; sold its B2C flagship Snaitech (Italy) to Flutter for EUR2.3bn in April 2025 to refocus purely on B2B/SaaS supply.
w_notes: Sold B2C Snaitech; refocused purely on B2B supply model
Snaitech sale funded dividend/debt paydown, not player acquisition
Commercial supply deals (Caliente JV) not funnel-repositioning alliances
AI features built for clients' players, not own surface
Minimal residual audience after divesting Snaitech's B2C reach
d_notes: Broad casino, live-casino, bingo, poker content via IMS
IMS platform is proven PAM/CRM/data rail at scale
No payments or merchant-of-record capability; pure content/platform supplier
Broad B2B footprint; minimal direct active-player base now
Not a consumer brand; players don't deposit with Playtech
ai_notes: Builds AI features on external models, not frontier training
Internal agentic tools for coding/QA only, not player-facing
No genuine conversational assistant; BetBuddy is risk-detection tool
AI-driven bet builder and personalized player journeys shipped
Aggregated cross-operator behavioral data via IMS platform
Consumer/integrator of AI, not a platform others build on
f_notes: Strong liquidity post-EUR2.3bn Snaitech sale proceeds
Profitable; EBITDA EUR197m FY2025, margin compressed post-sale
Public company with positive EBITDA; no runway concern
S&P downgraded credit rating following Snaitech divestment
LSE-listed; proven access to equity and debt markets
revenue_traction: Adjusted EBITDA EUR197m FY2025 (~20% above market expectations); SaaS revenue +73% to EUR57.3m (2025)
existing_partnerships: Caliente Interactive (Mexico JV, revised 2025 terms), Flutter Entertainment (Snaitech buyer, 2025)
foundation_model_approach: Builds on external/third-party AI models for personalization, bet-builder and internal agentic dev tooling; no evidence of proprietary frontier-model training.
proprietary_data_advantage: Aggregated behavioral/transaction data across many operator clients via the IMS platform, feeding personalization and BetBuddy safer-gambling AI.
responsible_gambling_stance: Proactive; BetBuddy AI-led safer-gambling tool live with multiple operator brands since FY2024.
impact_on_incumbent_line: Arms incumbent operators (Betsson, Entain, etc.) with content, platform and AI tooling rather than bypassing them -- reinforces the affiliate-operator model instead of disrupting it.
residual_gap: No wallet/payments/MoR, no owned player audience at scale, no consumer brand trust, no agentic-commerce protocol adoption -- only the product/content pillar is genuinely owned.
evidence_notes: Recent earnings calls/IR docs confirm the April 2025 Snaitech (Italy B2C) sale to Flutter for EUR2.3bn and a strategic pivot to pure B2B/SaaS (IMS platform, content licensing). AI evidence (BetBuddy, AI bet-builder, internal agentic dev tooling, personalization) drawn from FY2025 results commentary. No agentic-commerce protocol (MCP/A2A/UCP/ACP) or direct player-facing assistant found in available snippets.
notes: Legal entity Playtech plc (LSE: PTEC), Isle of Man-incorporated. Post-April 2025 Snaitech divestment (now Flutter-owned, do not double count as a Playtech asset), Playtech retains only minor residual B2C exposure via Sun Bingo, HappyBet (Germany) and the Caliente Interactive JV (Mexico); core identity is now B2B content/platform supplier. Scored consistent with Evolution AB anchor (also B2B supplier & platform, near-zero willingness) but Playtech scores somewhat higher on D and AI due to its broader IMS platform/CRM stack and shipped personalization/safer-gambling AI features.
